Sam R: Heads up 1 1 CloudPartnerX asked for a compact enablement session next Wed to onboard their infra team to our ref-arch + Terraform starter. Can we put together a 40m format and owners?
Nina P: I can take the reference-arch walkthrough. Suggest 8 slides: goals, topology, security notes, ops playbook, testing matrix, rollback, cost considerations, next steps.
Diego M: I'll own the Terraform demo. Proposing a minimal module that provisions network, instance, and runtime config. Demo flow: git clone -> terraform init/plan/apply -> verify endpoints.
Jun H: Important 1 partner will need guidance on private deployment (VPC peering and KMS). Can we include a short example how to mount KMS keys and restrict access?
Sam R: Good call. Add a 5-min KMS & network slide. Also need a marketplace packaging note: who will take the template publish to the marketplace?
Nina P: I can draft the marketplace metadata section (asset manifest, icons, license, support contact). We'll include a quick checklist for partner submission.
Diego M: Terraform snippet we'll demo: 
```hcl
module "cp_x_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits//cloudpartnerx/terraform/minimal"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "a10g.medium"
  enable_private_vpc = true
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
}
```
Jun H: I'll prep a 1-page security note: IAM roles required, least-privilege policy snippet, and notes on audit logs.
Sam R: Can infra spin up a short-lived demo org/project for the rehearsal? Prefer creds that expire after 36h. Nina, can you request?
Nina P: Yes, I'll file the infra request: project name cp-x-demo-2025-03-05. Adding Diego & Jun as collaborators.
enablement-bot: Event created: 2025-03-05 15:00 UTC. Rehearsal scheduled: 2025-03-04 15:00 UTC. Repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-refkits/cloudpartnerx/enablement-checklist.md
Diego M: I'll push the minimal module and a README with troubleshooting steps (ports, security group rules, model pull auth) by EOD tomorrow.
Jun H: I'll draft the KMS policy snippet and add it to docs/security/kms.md.
Sam R: Owners: Nina (ref-arch + marketplace), Diego (terraform + demo), Jun (security + QA). I'll coordinate slides and send invites. We should do a dry-run 24h before.
Nina P: Agreed. Adding rehearsal to calendar now.
Diego M: LGTM. I'll also create a smoke test script under tests/smoke/cloudpartnerx.sh
Sam R: Thanks team 1 will post PR links here when ready.
